vectors.name: conforming_baseline_1unit_va
vectors.description: FHFA 2026 baseline: $700,000 1-unit VA loan below the $832,750 baseline. Conforming. loan_program carried for chain gate routing.

vectors.name: ak_territory_baseline_conforming
vectors.description: Alaska 2026: the statutory uplift makes the territory baseline $1,249,125, and a loan at exactly that figure is ordinary conforming under the inclusive bound. No above-baseline band exists there by default.
